subject: SEND - New notification from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} - ${notification.iun}
body1: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>Your business has received a legally binding communication from ${notification.sender.paDenomination} with IUN Code ${notification.iun} on <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your<#else>its digital domicile, access SEND to consult it.
body2: This communication will be considered legally delivered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>to you</#if> 7 days* after receipt on <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your</#if> digital domicile, even if you do not open or read it.
perfection: <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>You have<#else>The business has</#if> 120 days from the moment the communication is delivered to consult the documents online. Afterward, they will no longer be available on SEND and <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you will have to contact<#else>it will have to contact</#if> the institution that sent them <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>to you</#if>.
payment: The deadline for payment, if applicable, and for any appeals is indicated in the documents.
banner: With the digital domicile, <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you will not receive paper notices and you will no longer have to<#else>your business will not receive paper notices and will no longer have to</#if> bear the shipping costs for registered mail.
footnote: *If <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>you received<#else>the business received</#if> the communication after 9 PM, the 7 days start from the following day.
footer: You are receiving this communication because you have entered <#if recipient.recipientType=='PF'>your email address<#else>the company email address among the courtesy contact details of SEND. To modify your contact details or add others, go to your contact details.
